name: Smash Sugar Parallelepipeds
author: Lázaro Albuquerque
description: A Breakout-style game: bounce the ball with your paddle and smash all the bricks, keeping track of your lives and score.

descriptions.en: A Breakout-style game: bounce the ball with your paddle and smash all the bricks, keeping track of your lives and score.
descriptions.it: Un gioco in stile Breakout: fai rimbalzare la palla con la racchetta e distruggi tutti i mattoncini, tenendo d'occhio vite e punteggio.
